name: seed-month-stats-data
title: Seed July 2026 statistics data in data.sql
description: Append realistic test data (users, schedules, shifts, time logs, orders, order details, inventory deductions) simulating a full month of restaurant operations for July 2026 so the menu engineering BCG report and prime cost report endpoints return non-empty data.
acceptance: data.sql extended with INSERT blocks for: users (1 admin + >=6 workers with salary), schedule, schedule_shifts, worker_schedule_assignments, user_assigned_areas, time_logs (IN entries), orders, order_details, order_detail_options, order_preparation_areas, inventory_movements (DEDUCTION linked to orders)
All orders fall within 2026-07-01 .. 2026-07-31, status DELIVERED, with realistic open_time/close_time/party_size
Idempotent: pre-existing July 2026 rows are cleared before insertion
Distribution: weekends busier; lunch peak 12-14, dinner peak 19-22
Top-selling products appear more frequently in order_details
inventory_movements DEDUCTION rows reference the order they came from

tasks.description: Extend data.sql with idempotent July 2026 seed: users, schedule, shifts, assignments, areas, time_logs
Generate ~2000 orders across July 2026 using CTE-based series; order_details with top-seller bias; order_detail_options; order_preparation_areas
Generate inventory_movements of type DEDUCTION linked to each order for COGS
Run ./gradlew spotlessApply and ./harness/harness.sh; verify all OK
